SELECT i.item_key, i.kind, i.item_id, i.title, i.path, i.line_start, i.line_end, i.status, i.symbol_kind, i.content_hash, i.body, i.meta, GROUP_CONCAT(l.target ORDER BY l.target SEPARATOR ',') AS matched FROM sdd_links l JOIN sdd_items i ON i.item_key = l.item_key WHERE i.kind = %s AND l.target IN (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s) GROUP BY i.item_key, i.kind, i.item_id, i.title, i.path, i.line_start, i.line_end, i.status, i.symbol_kind, i.content_hash, i.body, i.meta ORDER BY i.path, i.line_start

SELECT item_key, kind, item_id, title, path, line_start, line_end, status, symbol_kind, content_hash, body, meta, MATCH(search_text) AGAINST(%s IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) AS score FROM sdd_items WHERE kind = %s AND MATCH(search_text) AGAINST(%s IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) ORDER BY score DESC, item_id LIMIT %s
